# Triggers

| POST | `/api/v1/triggers/discover` | Discover the merge tokens a trigger source exposes |

### POST /api/v1/triggers/discover

Discover the merge tokens a trigger source exposes

Fetches an RSS/Atom feed, Ghost blog or WordPress site, samples its most recent item, and returns the merge tokens available to a post template built from it.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `source`: one of `"rss"` | `"ghost"` | `"wordpress"`, required
  - `url`: string (uri), required

**Responses**

- `200` — Tokens discovered on the source
  - `TriggerDiscovery`
    - `tokens`: array of `DiscoveredToken`, required
      - `token`: string, required — Merge token as it appears in a template, e.g. `{{title}}`.
      - `previewValue`: string, required — The value this token resolved to on the sampled item, truncated for display.
      - `kind`: one of `"text"` | `"url"` | `"image"` | `"date"` | `"list"`, required
    - `sampleSource`: string, required — Human-readable label for the item the tokens were sampled from, e.g. `First feed item · How I built X`.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
